description.narrative: Resilience and Livelihoods Guarantee (RLG) sub-limit* under the Resilience and Livelihoods Framework in the form of an unfunded portfolio risksharing instrument in the amount of up to €6.375 million. The guarantee covers up to 50 per cent of the credit risk in newly originated sub-loans with the total value of € 25.5 million equivalent (the "Covered Portfolio") subject to total 50 per cent of portfolio cap. The RLG Project will have 6 months inclusion period for the origination of the Covered Portfolio by the PFI, following which EBRD guarantee will have a maximum maturity of: (i) 2 years for 82% of the Covered Portfolio (expected to be represented by working capital Sub-Loans); and (ii) 5 years for 18% of the Covered Portfolio. *This sub-limit is part of EBRD's broader RLG facility to PCBU, covered by OpIDs 54477 and 54726 (under Resilience and Livelihoods Framework and Financial Intermediaries Framework, respectively), jointly referred to as the RLG Project. Both OpIDs are to be regulated under a single risk participation agreement with the PFI. The Facility will be used to support lending to Ukrainian private companies operating in the primary and secondary agriculture and other critical industries (inter alia food processing, retail, logistics), with the ultimate goal of preserving livelihoods in Ukraine.
